name: autocomplete
title: Autocomplete
description: Free text with optional typed suggestions, keyboard completion and native text submission.
api: boolean; closed Escape clears only when enabled
notes: Autocomplete uses the current Base UI free-text primitive; it is no longer an alias for selection-only Combobox. value/defaultValue and onValueChange carry text, including text absent from suggestions. Suggestion objects use itemToStringValue for displayed/completed text; native form submission contains the input text.

getOptionKey provides stable suggestion identity. renderOption and isOptionDisabled customize results. mode controls list/inline completion; AutocompletePrimitive exposes unstyled parts for grouped/inline-list/virtualized custom composition.
Closed Escape preserves text by default; clearOnEscape opts into clearing. The explicit clear button works independently of this preference.

name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Typed string or object selection with stable keys, custom rows, keyboard filtering and clearing.
api: boolean; closed Escape clears only when enabled
notes: String and numeric options work directly. Object records may use id/value plus label, or provide identity/display getters. Keys must be nonempty and unique; equal labels with different IDs are supported. Recreated option objects compare by key by default, and current option labels replace stale record labels.

Selection controls submit stable keys as native form values by default. Override itemToStringValue if your backend uses a different encoding. Disabled predicates apply to choices; removing an already selected chip remains an explicit action.
Escape dismisses an open popup without discarding committed values. Closed Escape preserves the value by default; clearOnEscape opts into clearing. Clear buttons and chip removal remain available.

Combobox is selection-only: value is T or null. Use Autocomplete for unrestricted text. ComboboxPrimitive exports unstyled Base UI parts for grouped, virtualized or fully custom compositions. The Autocomplete reexport from this entry now points to the real free-text component.

Selection controls submit stable keys as native form values by default. Override itemToStringValue if your backend uses a different encoding. Disabled predicates apply to choices; removing an already selected chip remains an explicit action.

name: tree
title: Tree
description: Hierarchical selection, expansion, typeahead and immutable drag or keyboard reordering.
primitive: Original APG tree + semantic HTML (no Base UI tree primitive)
notes: Data changes reconcile selected IDs: uncontrolled selection forgets records that are actually removed, and controlled owners receive the pruned keys through onSelectionChange. Collapsing a branch preserves the selection of its existing descendants.

If a focused item disappears or moves into a collapsed branch, focus moves to its visible ancestor, a surviving neighbor or the labeled empty group. Outside focus and pointer interactions remain with the control the user chose. The Dynamic data preview demonstrates these updates.

name: tag-group
title: Tags
description: Selectable and removable tag collections with roving focus and keyboard removal.
notes: onRemove is a request. Selection changes only after the owner removes records from items. Uncontrolled selection forgets removed IDs; controlled owners receive pruned keys through onSelectionChange. Reintroducing a deleted record does not automatically select it again.

Focus follows a surviving tag or the empty toolbar when the focused control is removed. Deferred removals preserve focus outside the collection. The Dynamic data preview demonstrates controlled selection, preserved records and queued local removal.

name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: Sortable, selectable, resizable and reorderable rows with pagination and optional cell navigation.
primitive: Optional TanStack Table v9 + Base UI Checkbox + semantic table/grid
notes: For automatic loading, constrain the table content with scrollAreaClassName (for example max-h-64 overflow-auto), keeping pagination outside the scrolling row area. autoLoadMore observes the canonical loader only on the last loaded client page. onLoadMore may return a promise and receives AbortSignal; hasMore=false retains a completed row without discarding focused controls.

With more records still available, a keyboard grid reports aria-rowcount=-1 rather than inventing a total. Once exhausted, counts include the header and retained loading row. Explicit row indices include the header. The page status describes loaded client pages while the backend supply is unknown.

name: table-load-more
title: Table Load More
description: Visibility-triggered row loading with progress keys, abortable requests and an accessible manual retry.
primitive: Semantic table row + native IntersectionObserver + Base UI Button
api: Element | Document | null / CSS margin string
notes: Place this part inside a native table body and set colSpan to the actual column count. Automatic observation is enabled by default; a manual action remains available for keyboard/touch use and browsers without IntersectionObserver. loading controls external pending work; return a promise so the component can also track completion and rejection. AbortSignal is cancelled on unmount; the owner decides how to stop its data request.

Pass a stable loadKey which changes only when data/cursor/query progress should permit another automatic request, such as rows.length or a query/cursor string. The default key allows one automatic request per mounted instance. A fresh intersection sample is required after key/root changes, avoiding an extra request from stale geometry after rows are appended. Unchanged progress, errors and repeated visibility callbacks do not cause an automatic request loop; retry remains explicit.

hasMore=false retains the completed action so keyboard focus is not discarded. Pending and completed actions may remain focusable but cannot activate. disabled blocks new work; an accepted request is not rolled back by disabling. The owner appends records and sets exhaustion. TableLoadMoreItem does not invent a backend or automatically fetch a URL.

Row className, cellProps.className and buttonClassName customize the separate parts. children render additional content before the action. labels localizes loadMore, loading, retry, complete, error and loaded text. A custom observer root must contain the row; rootMargin uses native pixel/percentage syntax.

DataTable composes this same source through onLoadMore, autoLoadMore, hasMore and loadKey. Automatic loading is opt-in there and waits until its last loaded client page; existing pagination remains explicit. Same component, source registry and npm implementation; no React Aria collection context is required.
